dependency_order: A `procedure` seeds prerequisites, safety conditions, permissions, and terms before the first dependent step (§4.4).

slots.name: Goal
slots.description: The end state the procedure produces.

slots.name: Scope
slots.description: Applicable systems, conditions, exclusions, and required authority.

slots.name: Prerequisites
slots.description: Access, tools, inputs, backups, captured state, and checks completed before the first change.

slots.name: Steps
slots.description: Ordered actions with named objects and stop conditions.

slots.name: Verification
slots.description: Observable checks and pass criteria for the goal.

slots.name: Rollback
slots.description: Steps that restore the prior safe state, or an explicit explanation of why rollback is unavailable.

slots.name: Failure and escalation
slots.description: Conditions for stopping, safe state while stopped, evidence to collect, and a named role or documented channel.
